pkgmetadata.longdescription: Clasp is a Common Lisp implementation that compiles to native code with LLVM and interops with C++. This ebuild follows AUR clasp-cl 3.0.1: the official release tarball, koga --skip-sync, and ninja install. The host Lisp is SBCL. LLVM 15-20 and 22 are supported upstream; 21 is skipped for an API break, and llvm-r2 drops slots older than 17.
